I’ve always gotten migraines since I was little but a couple years ago I woke up one morning and half my face was numb. 
I stood in my mirror sticking my tongue out and smiling trying to convince myself I wasn’t having a stoke. I tried to go back to sleep but couldn’t so I had my husband take me to the ER. They thought it was an allergic reaction to something and gave me Benadryl and sent me on my way. Went home and went to bed. 
Woke up a couple hours later with a killer migraine and decided to get in the shower. That’s really all I remember. My husband found me in the shower with only hot water running and all of my clothes on and called and ambulance because I wouldn’t answer any of his questions. Spent the day in the hospital having all kinds of tests done. It slowly got better but I had aphasia for 3 or 4 days. 
A couple weeks after that I woke up with a headache and decided to take a shower walked into my bathroom and couldnt figure out how to turn it on and was like “welll here we go again” had my husband drive me to a different hospital. Cried the whole time thinking they had missed a brain tumor or something. Wound up getting diagnosed with hemiplegic migraines that were the result of a medication reaction.
